body: I've voted yes on this, I'm excited for this to come to fruition, especially at such a critical (in a good way) period for Edgeware

This proposal funds a three-month contract with firm MarketAcross for public relations services, as well as hires Damoy, an Agency contact for 3 months to lead the PR efforts internally and own the results, see the full proposal:

[https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/859-edgeware-comms-strategy-discussion-document](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/859-edgeware-comms-strategy-discussion-document)
